question: Would identical post-repair outputs prove accurate unbiased scores, model improvement or all-system determinism?

criteria.instruction: No. N14 fixes this reduction-order source of variation; finite-precision consistency is separate from mathematical accuracy, unbiased scoring and predictive quality. The two selected runs are not a variance/quality dataset. Other clocks, inputs and model nondeterminism need their own checks.
Use N14 accuracy distinction and evidence limits/repair scope; avoid promoting one diagnostic into comprehensive reproducibility evidence.
Decline model-quality gains, population variance estimates, unbiasedness and whole-system deterministic certification from this sample.
